doc.state: whether this checkbox is checked, unchecked, or in an indeterminate state
doc.onClick: called when this checkbox is clicked. If `null`, then this checkbox will not be interactable, unless something else handles its input events and updates its [state].
doc.modifier: the [Modifier] to be applied to this checkbox
doc.enabled: controls the enabled state of this checkbox. When `false`, this component will not respond to user input, and it will appear visually disabled and disabled to accessibility services.
doc.colors: [CheckboxColors] that will be used to resolve the colors used for this checkbox in different states. See [CheckboxDefaults.colors].
doc.colors.checkedColor: the color that will be used for the border and box when checked
doc.colors.uncheckedColor: color that will be used for the border when unchecked. By default, the inner box is transparent when unchecked.
doc.colors.checkmarkColor: color that will be used for the checkmark when checked
doc.colors.disabledCheckedColor: color that will be used for the box and border when disabled and checked
doc.colors.disabledUncheckedColor: color that will be used for the border when disabled and unchecked. By default, the inner box is transparent when unchecked.
doc.colors.disabledIndeterminateColor: color that will be used for the box and border in a [TriStateCheckbox] when disabled AND in an [ToggleableState.Indeterminate] state
doc.interactionSource: an optional hoisted [MutableInteractionSource] for observing and emitting [Interaction]s for this checkbox. You can use this to change the checkbox's appearance or preview the checkbox in different states. Note that if `null` is provided, interactions will still happen internally.
